nine-nine-path3.objective: Build a Python 9x9 multiplication-table program for factors 1 through 9. Choose the implementation and CSV column labels yourself. Run your program, independently check all 81 mathematical results, fix any failures, and return real source code, program output, and a test report for reviewer analysis.

auto4-premerge-path3.objective: Implement a CPU-only Python program that prints CSV with exactly header n,triangular and 12 ordered rows for n=1 through 12, using the integer triangular-number result n*(n+1)//2. Run it on this runner, independently verify all twelve rows and edge cases n=1 and n=12, record actual commands, exit codes, and observed outcomes. Do not use hardware, network, SSH, sudo, or any non-Python package.

Report real synthesis, implementation, timing, DRC, BIT/HWH SHA256 and repeatability from those actual build results. No Z2, FPGA load, MMIO, USB, DUT or other physical operation.
